a: أَحْبَبْتُ لأَنَّ الرَّبَّ يَسْمَعُ صَوْتِي، تَضَرُّعَاتِي.
e: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

a: لأَنَّهُ أَمَالَ أُذْنَهُ إِلَيَّ فَأَدْعُوهُ مُدَّةَ حَيَاتِي.
e: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

a: اكْتَنَفَتْنِي حِبَالُ الْمَوْتِ. أَصَابَتْنِي شَدَائِدُ الْهَاوِيَةِ. كَابَدْتُ ضِيقًا وَحُزْنًا.
e: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

a: وَبِاسْمِ الرَّبِّ دَعَوْتُ: «آهِ يَا رَبُّ، نَجِّ نَفْسِي!».
e: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

a: ارْجِعِي يَا نَفْسِي إِلَى رَاحَتِكِ، لأَنَّ الرَّبَّ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ إِلَيْكِ.
e: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

a: لأَنَّكَ أَنْقَذْتَ نَفْسِي مِنَ الْمَوْتِ، وَعَيْنِي مِنَ الدَّمْعَةِ، وَرِجْلَيَّ مِنَ الزَّلَقِ.
e: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

a: أَسْلُكُ قُدَّامَ الرَّبِّ فِي أَرْضِ الأَحْيَاءِ.
e: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

a: أَنَا قُلْتُ فِي حَيْرَتِي: «كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ كَاذِبٌ».
e: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

a: مَاذَا أَرُدُّ لِلرَّبِّ مِنْ أَجْلِ كُلِّ حَسَنَاتِهِ لِي؟
e: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

a: كَأْسَ الْخَلاَصِ أَتَنَاوَلُ، وَبِاسْمِ الرَّبِّ أَدْعُو.
e: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.

a: أُوفِي نُذُورِي لِلرَّبِّ مُقَابِلَ كُلِّ شَعْبِهِ.
e: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.

a: عَزِيزٌ فِي عَيْنَيِ الرَّبِّ مَوْتُ أَتْقِيَائِهِ.
e: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

a: آهِ يَا رَبُّ، لأَنِّي عَبْدُكَ! أَنَا عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ. حَلَلْتَ قُيُودِي.
e: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

a: فَلَكَ أَذْبَحُ ذَبِيحَةَ حَمْدٍ، وَبِاسْمِ الرَّبِّ أَدْعُو.
e: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,

a: فِي دِيَارِ بَيْتِ الرَّبِّ، فِي وَسَطِكِ يَا أُورُشَلِيمُ. هَلِّلُويَا.
e: In the courts of the LORD'S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
